page.notes: The printed "s" long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. Verse references in the text are printed as shown (e.g. "v.66.", "v. 6o, 6i."); "6i" is read as an i-form numeral and may be 61 [?]. "traha" / "trabo" in "non trabo" is hard to read and is marked [?]. The right-margin "»" marks are printer's ditto marks and are not transcribed. The catchword "in para-" is set at the right below the last line.
